create_world_dm_env_rpc: create a new dm_env_rpc world on the server with the provided settings and return the world name
join_world_dm_env_adaptor: join an existing dm_env_rpc world and return a DmEnvAdaptor instance for interacting with the environment
create_and_join_world_dm_env_rpc: create a new dm_env_rpc world and immediately join it, returning the DmEnvAdaptor and world name
reset_dm_env_adaptor: reset the remote dm_env_rpc environment to its initial state and return the first time step
step_dm_env_adaptor: step the remote dm_env_rpc environment with the given actions and return the resulting time step
